column1: # mapping_set_title: Legislation: ELI 1.4 and Akoma Ntoso 1.0

column9: Both are the abstract act, the FRBR work, whatever its versions and languages. ELI's legal resource is the act itself, holding its metadata; Akoma Ntoso's FRBR work is the work level of a document's identification block, and an Akoma Ntoso document carries one for its own act. The act's number is the same in both, and the Akoma Ntoso work-level FRBR URI is the act's local identifier in ELI.
A property eli:LegalResource and akn:FRBRWork share.
A property eli:LegalResource and akn:FRBRWork share.

Both are a version of the act in one language, the FRBR expression: an original, amended or consolidated text. ELI gives an expression its title and publication dates; Akoma Ntoso its version number, languages and whether it is authoritative. The expression-level FRBR URI is the expression's local identifier in ELI.
A property eli:LegalExpression and akn:FRBRExpression share.
Both are an embodiment of an expression in a format, the FRBR manifestation, e.g. the Akoma Ntoso XML or a PDF. The manifestation-level FRBR URI is the format's local identifier in ELI.
A property eli:Format and akn:FRBRManifestation share.

Both are a part of an act at any level, from a chapter to an article or a paragraph. ELI identifies a subdivision as a legal resource of its own, part of the act; Akoma Ntoso marks it up as a hierarchical element of the act's body, with its number and heading. Their numbers are written differently, e.g. 5 and 5., so the crosswalk doesn't compare them.

An organization that passes, publishes or holds the rights to an act. ELI identifies the organization by its IRI; an Akoma Ntoso TLC reference stands for it within one document, pointing at the same IRI by its href, and the document's text and metadata refer to it through the reference.
A property eli:Organization and akn:TLCOrganization share.
A person involved in an act, identified by an IRI in ELI and by a TLC reference pointing at it in Akoma Ntoso.
A property eli:Person and akn:TLCPerson share.

A subject an act is about, from a thesaurus or authority table: an ELI work is about a SKOS concept, an Akoma Ntoso term in the text refers to a TLC concept pointing at the same IRI. ELI's concept also stands for authority-table values, such as languages or resource types, which Akoma Ntoso holds as attribute values rather than references.
A property eli:Concept and akn:TLCConcept share.
